_comment: Mentors listed on mentors-2025.html — the 17 who mentored the first cohort. Entries marked {"ref": true} are pulled from mentors-2026.json so shared people are written once; they also carry the 'Also mentoring in 2026' badge. Descriptions are condensed from Mentor information for website (Responses) 2025, a form whose stated purpose is the website. Portraits are matched by filename in assets/img/mentors/.

mentors.name: Ibrahim Tahmid
mentors.blurb: Studies how much of a person’s thinking can be read from their gaze, and uses eye tracking to build real-time assistants for immersive environments — along with the design problems such agents raise.

mentors.name: Hasan Mahmud Prottoy
mentors.blurb: Investigates how people adapt technology to work around infrastructural limits, particularly in the global south, drawing on critical HCI, postcolonial computing and participatory design to make technology design more equitable.

mentors.name: Mostofa Rafid Uddin
mentors.blurb: Builds unsupervised and self-supervised methods for multi-scale generative modelling of subcellular objects, and adapts them to 2D and 3D biological images.

mentors.name: Sourav Saha
mentors.blurb: Applies pretrained language models — transformers and state space models — to genomics data, particularly post-transcriptional regulatory mechanisms, with earlier research and industry work in Bangla NLP.

mentors.name: Kazi Mejbaul Islam
mentors.blurb: Explores fault attacks on deep neural network accelerators across FPGA, TPU and GPU hardware.

mentors.name: Turash Haque Pial
mentors.blurb: Models bio and soft materials and nano-microfluidic systems, combining physical chemistry, statistical physics and machine learning. Projects include polyelectrolyte-grafted nanochannels, peptide-amphiphile nanofibre formation, and siRNA payload distribution in lipid nanoparticles.

mentors.name: Sadman Sadeed Omee
mentors.affil: PhD candidate · University of South Carolina
mentors.blurb: Develops graph neural networks, transformers and diffusion models for materials informatics — crystal structure prediction, property prediction, and generative modelling of materials. The crystal structure problem is a close cousin of protein structure prediction.

mentors.name: Rahat Mahmud Khan
mentors.blurb: Works on defrosting and deicing strategies that cut energy use and downtime, studying how frost nucleates and grows across temperature, humidity and surface wettability, and developing electro-thermal defrosting using conductive thin-film coatings.

mentors.name: Ahmed Imtiaz Zamee
mentors.blurb: Works on transportation safety, currently wrong-way driving detection technologies and school bus safety, using statistical analysis, machine learning and video analytics alongside survey data collection.
